preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= n <= 10**6 for n, k in zip(n_values, k_values))
preconditions.description: For each test case, 1 <= k <= n <= 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(s[i] in '01' for s in s_values for i in range(len(s)))
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][0] == 'YES' if any(any(s[j] == t[l] for j in range(i, i+k)) for l in range(k)) else output[i][0] == 'NO' for i, (n, k, s) in enumerate(zip(n_values, k_values, s_values)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of the output is 'YES' if there exists a beautiful string t, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][1] == min(t for t in product('01', repeat=k) if all(any(s[j] == t[l] for j in range(i, i+k)) for l in range(k))) if output[i][0] == 'YES' else True for i, (n, k, s) in enumerate(zip(n_values, k_values, s_values)))
postconditions.description: If the first line of the output is 'YES', the second line is the lexicographically smallest beautiful string t.
